marketplace.summary: Designs estimand-anchored, registry-informed clinical trial protocols—endpoints, eligibility, sample size, randomization, interim rules, and reporting checks—for research and regulatory planning without giving individual treatment advice or implying ethics approval.

skills.name: clinical-trial-protocol-skill
skills.description: Researches similar registered trials and FDA pathways, then drafts NIH/FDA-template protocol sections for a drug or device, with a two-arm sample size script.

skills.name: endpoint-definition-designer
skills.description: Turns study objectives into operational primary, secondary, and exploratory endpoints with event rules, timing windows, composite logic, and ambiguity review.

skills.name: inclusion-exclusion-criteria-builder
skills.description: Converts a target population into executable, time-anchored inclusion and exclusion criteria tied to verifiable evidence sources, with edge-case adjudication rules.

skills.name: sample-size-and-power-planning-assistant
skills.display_name: Sample Size and Power Planning Assistant
skills.description: Plans sample-size logic, audits the quality of every power assumption, and builds conservative and feasibility-bound fallback scenarios instead of false-precision N.

skills.name: randomization-gen
skills.description: Generates permuted-block allocation schedules for multi-arm RCTs from a bundled script, as input to a separately controlled allocation-concealment process.

skills.name: adaptive-trial-simulator
skills.description: Monte Carlo simulation of group-sequential and sample-size re-estimation designs for a two-arm continuous endpoint, summarizing power, stopping rates, and type I error.

skills.name: tooluniverse-clinical-trial-design
skills.description: Scores early-phase trial feasibility across population, biomarker, endpoint, comparator, safety, and regulatory paths; built on ToolUniverse, usable here via Connectors.

skills.name: sop-writer
skills.description: Drafts standard operating procedures with purpose, scope, responsibilities, numbered steps, quality control, and documentation sections for clinical or lab workflows.

skills.name: clinicaltrials-database
skills.description: Queries ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 by condition, intervention, sponsor, status, or phase and retrieves registered design, eligibility, and outcome fields by NCT ID.

skills.name: reporting-guideline-compliance-checker
skills.description: Checks trial and other biomedical manuscripts against CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, or TRIPOD and grades missing or weakly reported items by submission risk.
